Outcome: Every authored value and acceptance criterion is retained without changing another project.

Synthetic acceptance data; configure real dependencies before live execution.

records.title: Validate create a project with explicit application scopes failure boundary
records.description:
Project visibility, description and application platform define the workspace context. Application selection must remain within the chosen project.

Boundary under review: Reject missing names and cross-project application references; do not change another project.

records.title: Validate apply project membership and workspace role grants accurately failure boundary
records.description:
Membership determines project access; workspace role presets provide Product Owner, QA, Automation, AI, Reporter and Viewer responsibilities. Sample setup must preserve customized grants.

Boundary under review: An authenticated non-administrator cannot modify workspace roles or add privileged membership.

records.title: Validate navigate available capabilities without leaking project scope failure boundary
records.description:
The workspace navigator combines capabilities, feature availability and project permissions. Restricted, disabled and missing-project states must remain distinguishable.

Boundary under review: A direct URL must enforce the same permissions as the navigation control.

records.title: Validate maintain authenticated sessions and recover expired access failure boundary
records.description:
Authentication controls protected workspace APIs and pages. Session expiry must result in a clear sign-in path without treating a failed request as a successful save.

Boundary under review: Invalid or expired credentials must not expose project records or admin content.

records.title: Validate delete large projects with recoverable background progress failure boundary
records.description:
Deletion uses a durable job receipt, bounded SQL batches and post-commit storage cleanup. The requester can continue monitoring after project membership disappears.

Boundary under review: Conflicting cross-project references stop the job safely; never show completion while stored-file cleanup remains.

records.title: Validate persist workspace preferences and regional presentation failure boundary
records.description:
Settings and regional controls influence labels and formatting without rewriting stored delivery dates or identifiers. Governed defaults remain separate from personal choices.

Boundary under review: Unsupported localization values fall back safely instead of breaking page rendering.

records.title: Validate author stories with actionable specifications and ownership failure boundary
records.description:
Stories support Gherkin or Spec Kit specifications alongside title, description, priority, status, effort, assignee, original Dev/QA and delivery dates.

Boundary under review: Reject an empty title and invalid project references without discarding the user draft.

records.title: Validate prioritize unscheduled stories and move them into a sprint failure boundary
records.description:
Backlog is the unscheduled view of the same story records. Moving work changes canonical iteration membership rather than copying stories.

Boundary under review: A filtered or paginated view must not silently move stories that were not selected.

records.title: Validate plan sprint goals, dates, ownership and lifecycle failure boundary
records.description:
Sprints have description, goal, labels, owner, effort and start/end dates with future, active and closed lifecycle states. Stories and sprint metrics derive from canonical membership.

Boundary under review: A sprint from another project cannot be assigned to the story; invalid date order must be rejected.

records.title: Validate create release milestones with explicit and sprint-inherited scope failure boundary
records.description:
Releases contain a unique project milestone, fix version, description, target information and linked sprints. Scope can include manually selected stories and stories inherited through sprints.

Boundary under review: Do not include another project’s story or count the same story twice through manual and inherited scope.

records.title: Validate use available sprints and releases consistently across story dialogs failure boundary
records.description:
Local project sprints and releases are the canonical options. Imported metadata may supplement choices but must not replace a native iteration ID with a legacy label.

Boundary under review: Loading errors must not appear as an empty catalog, and project switches must discard stale options.

records.title: Validate relate stories to test cases, defects and dependencies failure boundary
records.description:
Story links connect acceptance intent to test cases, Defects and related stories. Traceability counts represent unique linked records, not execution completion.

Boundary under review: Duplicate links must not inflate coverage and unrelated-project evidence must not be attachable.

records.title: Validate import and synchronize stories while retaining delivery metadata failure boundary
records.description:
Story import and configured tracker synchronization retain source references and map supported fields. Imported labels must not be mistaken for canonical local sprint or release IDs.

Boundary under review: Do not create duplicate stories on a supported repeat import or overwrite unrelated local edits without the chosen sync behavior.

records.title: Validate review AI-assisted story refinement and proposed test coverage failure boundary
records.description:
The story AI workspace helps refine requirements and generate reviewable design artifacts using a configured provider and permitted context. Suggestions are drafts until accepted.

Boundary under review: Provider failure or missing configuration leaves the original story intact and exposes a retryable explanation.

records.title: Validate author structured test cases with ordered steps and expected results failure boundary
records.description:
A case records title, description, type, priority, lifecycle, author and ordered actions with expected results. Case links and module/suite context must survive editing.

Boundary under review: Editing one case must not mutate another case’s independent steps or application scope.

records.title: Validate preserve Gherkin Features, Backgrounds and Scenario Outlines failure boundary
records.description:
Gherkin authoring preserves feature-level context and behavior steps. Dataset examples and parameter placeholders must remain aligned with the saved structured representation.

Boundary under review: Do not expose resolved sensitive parameter values inside visible Gherkin text.

records.title: Validate reuse shared step groups without losing parameter boundaries failure boundary
records.description:
Shared groups support structured and Gherkin content plus parameters. References must preserve local case behavior and the source group identity.

Boundary under review: Deleting or changing a reference must not delete independent steps belonging to another case.

records.title: Validate organize cases into modules and reusable ordered suites failure boundary
records.description:
Modules organize test design; suites select execution membership. Stored membership and order must agree with the run scope produced from the suite.

Boundary under review: A hidden case outside the active selection must not be added merely because it matches a broad filter.

records.title: Validate retain case revision history and review ownership failure boundary
records.description:
Case history preserves prior snapshots and change summaries. Review and author metadata provide accountability without inventing execution evidence.

Boundary under review: History views must not silently overwrite the current version or attribute changes to a different actor.

records.title: Validate round-trip supported test case imports and exports failure boundary
records.description:
Import/export covers supported case fields and step structures. Users must be able to review mapping and row-level errors before trusting the imported scope.

Boundary under review: Reject unsupported or malformed input without reporting uncreated cases as successfully imported.

records.title: Validate configure environment targets and scoped variables failure boundary
records.description:
Environment configuration stores a base URL and variables within project/application scope. Run creation selects permitted environments and freezes the chosen context.

Boundary under review: Variables from an unrelated application must not leak into the selected run.

records.title: Validate select browser and mobile configuration profiles failure boundary
records.description:
Profiles describe supported browser, platform, mobile OS/version and configuration variables. Selection must remain compatible with application scope and configured engine support.

Boundary under review: An unavailable device or unsupported target must produce an actionable state rather than a fabricated successful execution.

records.title: Validate link datasets and apply parameter precedence consistently failure boundary
records.description:
Datasets contain named columns and rows and can be linked to cases or runs. Execution preserves the selected input row and the parameter scopes used to resolve it.

Boundary under review: Missing required input must be visible and one row’s values must not overwrite another row’s results.

records.title: Validate review AI case mapping, step rephrase and synthetic data drafts failure boundary
records.description:
Configured AI can help map cases, rephrase steps or rich text and propose synthetic dataset rows. Accepted content still uses ordinary validation and saving paths.

Boundary under review: A provider error must retain the original draft and must not insert fabricated completion evidence.

records.title: Validate create a run from authorized suites and explicit delivery context failure boundary
records.description:
Run setup combines suite/case selection, assignments, environment, configuration, data and optional Release, Sprint and Build fields.

Boundary under review: An empty or unauthorized execution scope must not be reported as a successful run.

records.title: Validate record manual case and step outcomes against frozen run snapshots failure boundary
records.description:
Runs snapshot selected cases, steps and input context. Manual outcomes, notes, attachments and defects belong to the saved run evidence, not a moving case definition.

Boundary under review: An unfinished case must remain unfinished; unsaved or failed outcome writes must not appear finalized.

records.title: Validate calculate final case outcomes across dataset iterations failure boundary
records.description:
A case may have multiple data-row attempts. Case and run metrics must use the supported finalized-outcome policy and preserve individual iteration evidence.

Boundary under review: A later retry or multiple passed rows must not inflate unique case totals or mask a relevant failed outcome.

records.title: Validate manage disabled, future and recurring run schedules failure boundary
records.description:
Schedules retain project/application, suite selection, execution context, assignees and cadence. Installation examples remain disabled until explicitly configured.

Boundary under review: Disabled schedules and projects being deleted must not be claimed for new work.

records.title: Validate inspect execution reports and AI-assisted failure analysis failure boundary
records.description:
Reports and analysis use the permitted run scope, saved result evidence and configured AI capability. Exported outcomes must agree with visible finalized metrics.

Boundary under review: Provider failure or missing evidence must not be presented as a confirmed root cause.

records.title: Validate capture and triage Defects with severity, ownership and history failure boundary
records.description:
Defects capture description, type, severity, priority, status, root cause, regression information and delivery/environment context. History preserves the investigation trail.

Boundary under review: Reporter access allows permitted creation but must not implicitly grant edit or delete access to existing Defects.

records.title: Validate review duplicate Defects and linked evidence before creating another failure boundary
records.description:
Duplicate review uses selected case/module context. Story, case, suite and run relationships let investigators reach supporting evidence without losing source scope.

Boundary under review: A similar title is a candidate, not proof of duplication; unauthorized evidence must remain inaccessible.

records.title: Validate turn Defect findings into reviewed regression coverage failure boundary
records.description:
Defect-to-case conversion maps supported defect details into an editable test draft. Configured AI assistance can help draft or triage without replacing human review.

Boundary under review: Conversion must not close the Defect or claim the resulting test passed.

records.title: Validate link executable automation to its manual coverage failure boundary
records.description:
Automation status and manual-to-automation links describe coverage readiness. An executable counterpart must retain its application scope and source case relationship.

Boundary under review: An automation link alone must not be interpreted as a passed run or complete acceptance coverage.

records.title: Validate review executable assets and step-level code before running failure boundary
records.description:
The automation workspace exposes supported assets, builder operations and step-level code. Feature controls independently govern previews and saved code views.

Boundary under review: Do not show unexecuted generated code as a verified passing automation result.

records.title: Validate configure API requests, validations and captured parameters failure boundary
records.description:
API steps store method, URL, headers, body mode, validations and captures. Preview validates configured requests and returns observed response information.

Boundary under review: Missing credentials, invalid targets and request timeouts must not be reported as successful assertions.

records.title: Validate curate stable object bindings with locator provenance failure boundary
records.description:
Objects retain screen/page intent, names, locators, platform metadata, source and confidence. Reuse should preserve why a binding was chosen.

Boundary under review: Low-confidence or duplicate candidates must not silently replace a reviewed stable binding.

records.title: Validate capture browser actions and review saved automation steps failure boundary
records.description:
Step-level recording connects a configured recording environment to case authoring and object bindings. Finishing recording saves supported captured steps; the updated plan can then be reviewed and edited.

Boundary under review: A disconnected recorder must expose recovery state and must not claim missing interactions were captured.

records.title: Validate run supported automation locally and retain its evidence failure boundary
records.description:
Local execution connects the selected case and context to the configured desktop/Playwright runner. Local Runs exposes recorded attempts and their outcomes.

Boundary under review: An offline agent must fail clearly rather than leaving the UI waiting indefinitely or fabricating a run result.

records.title: Validate dispatch remote automation with bounded parallel execution failure boundary
records.description:
Remote dispatch and parallel execution use configured engine capabilities. Worker ownership, progress and callbacks must remain associated with the correct project and run.

Boundary under review: Retries must not double-count attempts; unavailable workers must produce an observable recoverable state.

records.title: Validate use configured Android and Appium execution targets failure boundary
records.description:
Mobile execution depends on the configured mobile engine, Appium and device availability. Configuration and locator strategy must remain compatible with the chosen mobile target.

Boundary under review: No connected device or an unsupported platform must yield an actionable error, not simulated evidence.

records.title: Validate generate reviewable automation artifacts from selected source failure boundary
records.description:
Repository agents accept supported source inputs and generate bounded review artifacts. Source provenance and configured AI/runtime requirements remain visible.

Boundary under review: A source scan or generated candidate must not be presented as an executed, passing test.

records.title: Validate ingest supported project evidence and supplied content into knowledge failure boundary
records.description:
Knowledge supports selected project records, supplied text, supported files and URLs. Extraction, revision and indexing state show when a source is actually searchable.

Boundary under review: Images require supplied captions and audio/video require transcripts; do not invent extracted content.

records.title: Validate search versioned knowledge within authorized project scope failure boundary
records.description:
Retrieval uses available lexical and semantic indexing, source versions and access bindings. Collection filters must retain project-level security.

Boundary under review: Cross-project or unauthorized source passages must never appear in search results.

records.title: Validate answer project questions with current evidence and explicit gaps failure boundary
records.description:
The assistant combines permitted live project facts with relevant knowledge and product guidance. Provider outages retain deterministic evidence-backed fallback behavior.

Boundary under review: Missing or conflicting evidence must not become an invented project fact or unsupported completion claim.

records.title: Validate compose specialist workflows with validated steps and outputs failure boundary
records.description:
Workflow definitions contain triggers, agent steps, context scopes, edges and outputs. Drafts are not executed by sample installation.

Boundary under review: Invalid graphs or unsupported specialist IDs must be rejected before dispatch.

records.title: Validate inspect workflow attempts and per-step recovery states failure boundary
records.description:
Workflow history retains attempts, step outcomes and generated review artifacts. Observed execution state remains distinct from the editable workflow definition.

Boundary under review: An interrupted step must not appear completed merely because the workflow definition contains an output node.

records.title: Validate reuse prompt templates and governed AI provider mappings failure boundary
records.description:
Prompt templates retain scope, tags and applicable entities. Provider mappings select a configured project-compatible integration; credentials remain governed configuration.

Boundary under review: Do not embed real provider credentials in reusable sample prompts or claim a live model response when none ran.

records.title: Validate explain quality metrics with consistent scope and denominators failure boundary
records.description:
Quality analytics aggregates authorized project records. Unique traceability, finalized execution outcomes and readiness signals answer different questions and must be labeled clearly.

Boundary under review: Zero evidence must not imply a 100% pass rate, and duplicate joins must not inflate coverage.

records.title: Validate build reusable Executive, Product and QA dashboards failure boundary
records.description:
Custom dashboards preserve layouts, widget configuration and supported data sources. Templates provide starting points while evidence remains project-scoped.

Boundary under review: A saved template or empty widget must not invent project outcomes.

records.title: Validate review release readiness from traceability, execution and Defect risk failure boundary
records.description:
Readiness relates release scope to linked cases, execution results and unresolved defects. The page presents the evidence and its limitations rather than replacing human approval.

Boundary under review: Missing tests or stale results must remain visible; a count alone cannot certify a release as safe.

records.title: Validate keep Stories, Backlog, Sprint and Release cards mathematically consistent failure boundary
records.description:
Product metrics use the same status normalization, unique story scope and traceability rules across lists and tiles. Full-scope totals must remain independent of loaded pagination.

Boundary under review: Filtered and global totals must be labeled correctly; textual status aliases must not produce conflicting completion counts.

records.title: Validate monitor background work and download reusable artifacts failure boundary
records.description:
TestOps exposes permitted background transactions, progress, events and artifacts from imports, AI and automation. Management controls are governed separately from read access.

Boundary under review: A polling failure must remain retryable and must not trigger duplicate destructive work.

records.title: Validate investigate operational health and distributed request traces failure boundary
records.description:
OPS telemetry groups dashboards, TestGrid worker and project execution telemetry, infrastructure logs, distributed traces, alerts, and service health in tabs. Missing collectors or unavailable evidence must be presented accurately.

Boundary under review: Never fabricate trace spans or healthy metrics when the collector is unavailable.

records.title: Validate review relevant notifications and retain read state failure boundary
records.description:
Notifications provide user-scoped activity with read state and destination links. Counts and unread indicators must reflect the actual permitted records.

Boundary under review: A user must not read or modify another user’s notifications.

records.title: Validate install selected sample modules in dependency order without resetting edits failure boundary
records.description:
Instance setup offers module previews and explicit dependency selection. Project/apps and missing active-administrator memberships precede sprint/release/story records; installation is transactional and repeatable.

Boundary under review: Audit or ownership conflicts roll back installation; setup must not enable external services or execute sample workflows.

records.title: Validate govern feature availability and domain dropdown values failure boundary
records.description:
Feature flags and domain metadata shape available actions and permitted choices. Existing values require safe display even when the selectable catalog changes.

Boundary under review: A disabled feature must remain disabled after sample installation or direct API access.

records.title: Validate configure provider integrations and scoped API keys failure boundary
records.description:
Integration setup supports configured providers and connection checks. API keys retain their permitted routes/scopes and must not bypass ordinary project authorization.

Boundary under review: Sample examples remain inactive and credential-free; never expose stored secrets in catalogs or artifacts.

records.title: Validate separate administrator access and retain setup audit activity failure boundary
records.description:
The admin portal governs administrator access, setup, feature availability and audit/security views. Product project roles alone do not grant workspace administration.

Boundary under review: An audit failure during transactional setup must not leave a partially installed workspace.

records.title: Validate find support guidance without changing workspace data failure boundary
records.description:
The Support page provides the available help surface. Guidance should identify the current product area and preserve the user’s project context.

Boundary under review: Reading help must not initiate an external support request or transmit project data.

records.title: Validate execute reviewed browser quality checks with traceable evidence failure boundary
records.description:
A typed browser plan is reviewed before execution. Durable scoped jobs return recorded stages, measured metrics, findings and authenticated screenshot artifacts. Findings can become reviewed Defects and visual captures can become explicitly approved baselines.

Boundary under review: Missing browser infrastructure or incomplete steps block execution. Passive security, single-navigation performance and automated accessibility checks disclose their limits; an unapproved visual capture cannot claim a passed regression.
